messages:
alex.w: Quick RFC follow-up — leaning toward a tiny proxy shim (edge sidecar) to translate v3 requests to v4 at ingress. Keeps clients untouched and buys us time for SDKs. Thoughts?
vivian: 👍  proxy makes rollout deterministic. main worry is operational complexity and latency tail for small requests.
sahil: Can we keep it feature-flagged per-tenant? opt-in first, then auto-opt after telemetry looks good.
jamie: Agreed on flags. Also need a plan for telemetry so we can measure correctness (response schema diffs) and perf delta per tenant.
alex.w: Proposal: 1) proxy shim only handles payload reshape + header mapping, 2) add an explainable transform log, 3) opt-in flag. Minimal behavior change.
infra-bot: deploy queued: staging/shim-proxy v0.1.0 — rolling 3 nodes (ETA 4m)
maria: For telemetry, let's ship a compatibility-check endpoint in the shim that returns a small signature: `{status: "ok", changes: ["body/choices/format"]}` and emit to observability with tenant tag.
kevin: Important: we must avoid double-encoding issues clients accidentally rely on. Add tests that run golden prompts and assert token-level equality when possible.
sahil: Also add a safety net: if transform fails or latency > 300ms, route to v3 runtime (fallback) and emit a deprecation counter.
jamie: Ops question — does shim maintain KV cache or purely stateless? stateless keeps infra simple.
alex.w: Stateless for now. If we see dramatic perf loss we can add sticky cache short-term.
maria: About rollout windows: opt-in for 2 weeks on internal tenants, then 1 week canary 10% of prod, then open. Telemetry thresholds: schema mismatch < 0.1% and median p50 latency delta < 20ms.
kevin: Add a tenant-level kill-switch flag in Console and a short TTL on the opt-in so we can expire experimental shims.
sahil: I'll draft the shim contract and the observability events. also adding an `x-rw-transform` header so SDKs can detect transformed responses.
jamie: Small SDK note: we'll add a warning in client logs when `x-rw-transform` present, so users know behavior changed.
alex.w: Next steps: Sahil to PR shim prototype + metrics, Maria to add obs dashboard, Jamie to coordinate SDK logging. We'll sync mid-week. Thanks all :rocket:
